SELECT id, type, amount, source, record_time, remark, audit_status, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, create_time FROM finance_record
ORDER BY record_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, type, amount, source, record_time, remark, audit_status, audit_by, audit_time, audit_remark, create_time FROM finance_record
ORDER BY record_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalIncome, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS totalExpense, COUNT(1) AS recordCount FROM finance_record
AND audit_status IN (0, 2)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 1 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS income, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 2 THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expense FROM finance_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status IN (0, 2) AND record_time >= DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL #{months} MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(record_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC
SELECT source AS name, IFNULL(SUM(amount), 0) AS value FROM finance_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND audit_status IN (0, 2) AND type = #{type} GROUP BY source ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 6

SELECT id, type, amount, source, record_time, remark, create_time, delete_time FROM finance_record WHERE deleted = 1
AND (source LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY delete_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE finance_record SET deleted = 1, delete_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE finance_record SET deleted = 0, delete_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM finance_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 1
